_comment: Standalone Tool resource (POST /v1/convai/tools, body: {"tool_config": <this object minus this comment>}). Referenced by 03_daphne_family_history.create.json via tool_ids, NOT inlined in prompt.tools -- see that file's metadata.notes for why. Live tool_id: tool_1701m063xzjfe42be1327ddntmmv.
name: log_health_fact
description: Log a single structured family health fact the patient just stated. Call this immediately after the patient states a discrete fact about a relative, one call per fact.

person.description: The family relation, e.g. 'mother', 'father', 'sibling', 'maternal_grandmother'. Never 'self' in this stage.

description.description: Normalized description of the condition/event, e.g. 'breast cancer', 'heart attack', 'rheumatoid arthritis'.

approx_age.description: Relative's approximate age at diagnosis, if known. Omit if unknown.

still_living.description: Whether the relative is still living, if mentioned. Omit if not mentioned.

confidence.description: How precise/certain the patient's statement was.
